locNote.ceb: Pin: BCWD compound sa Km. 5, Alviola Village, kung asa sab ang BCWD property office ug supply warehouse. Amihanan nga kilid sa highway, mga 300 m sa kasadpan sa Bombo Radyo. Kumpirmaha ang eksaktong gate.
locNote.en: Pin: the BCWD compound at Km. 5, Alviola Village, which also holds the BCWD property office and supply warehouse. North side of the highway, about 300 m west of Bombo Radyo. Confirm the exact gate.

locNote.ceb: Pin: sentro sa Brgy. Buhangin. Wala pa mahibal-i ang eksaktong lugar sa estasyon.
locNote.en: Pin: centre of Brgy. Buhangin. The exact station spot is not yet known.

stations.name: Pump Station No. 17 – near Filtration Plant

locNote.ceb: Pin: sentro sa Brgy. Taguibo. Ang filtration plant naa sa may Taguibo River.
